page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-24-lssd is a memory-optimized and storage-equipped server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it features 12 physical cores and 24 vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is configured with 186.0 GB of dedicated RAM, providing 7.75 GB of memory per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of four NVMe SSDs totaling 1343 GB of capacity.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-core capabilities, with Geekbench single-core scores and single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression rates placing in the top 10% tier. Multi-core performance is also notable, with Geekbench multi-core and image processing benchmarks ranking in the top 25%. The CPU features advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), which contribute to strong performance in small-model LLM text generation, reaching 394.37 tokens per second. Memory bandwidth and database operations perform in the average tier.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c4-highmem-24-lssd offers a dense resource profile, balancing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio with high-speed local NVMe storage. This configuration is highly suitable for memory-intensive workloads that require fast local scratch space, such as relational databases, in-memory caching layers, data processing pipelines, and small-scale machine learning inference tasks.
